title: Concept: Standing instruction detail in a response
description: A standing order or direct-debit record with its amount in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The record names the beneficiary and the recurring amount, which describes the customer's obligations and cash flow without any need for the value to reach the page.
applicability: Payments hub, mandate management and account summary pages.
risk: Recurring obligations reveal income timing and commitments that support targeted fraud and social engineering.
